name: UNCX Network V3 Locker
not_assessed: shared control: the score says no key is shared, but this contract's own independent read lists another tracked contract with the same admin (unresolved, 12/10: do not read "no key shared" as established)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: Owned by a real 2-of-3 Gnosis Safe (v1.4.1, no module, guard slot zero, three bare-EOA owners) with no timelock in the path. Simulated against the live contract, that Safe cannot withdraw or migrate any locked position, but it can name the auto-collect account and zero a lock’s protocol fee, which lets that lock’s uncollected trading fees be redirected.
narrative.detail: The locker is non-upgradeable and every state-changing function in UNCX’s public source is present in the deployed bytecode. Principal stays out of the Safe’s reach (withdraw, migrate and decreaseLiquidity are gated by each lock’s own owner), and the score of 31 rests on the 2-of-3 threshold with no discount for these limits. UNCX’s second locker (unicrypt-v4) shares the same owner Safe but is not tracked.

steps.what: owner() on the contract: the holder
getOwners() on the holder: the signer set (word 2 is the count)
getModulesPaginated(0x1, 50) on the holder: the modules (a module executes without the signatures)
the guard slot of the holder (keccak of guard_manager.guard.address)
